def VTask.ofLeftInverse {α : Sort u_3} {β : Type u_4}
  (f : α → β)
  (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α)
  (hf : ∀ h : Nonempty α, Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) :
  α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) :=
{
  toFun := fun a => ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩,
  invFun := fun s => f_inv (Nonempty.ofExists s.2) s.1,
  left_inv := by
    intro a
    let hne := Nonempty.ofExists ⟨a, rfl⟩
    let g := f_inv hne
    have hg := hf hne
    exact hg a,
  right_inv := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := s
    let hne := Nonempty.ofExists hy
    let g := f_inv hne
    have hg := hf hne
    obtain ⟨a, hfa⟩ := hy
    have g_y_eq_a : g y = a := by
      calc
        g y = g (f a) := by rw [hfa]
        _ = a := by exact hg a
    have fx_eq_y : f (g y) = y := by
      rw [g_y_eq_a, hfa]
    exact Subtype.eq fx_eq_y
}
